# code-symbol-index

> Symbol index for Python codebases built from ast: definitions with signatures, ranked fuzzy search, incremental updates by hash and a stable JSON format Python package `trysac-code-symbol-index`, import name `code_symbol_index`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
